chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ النَّجَاشِيِّ: عَنْ شَيْخِنَا الْمُفِيدِ فِي كِتَابِهِ مَصَابِيحُ النُّورِ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ قُلْوَيْهَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ بَابَوَيْهَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْحِميريِّ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ الْجَعْفَرِيِّ، قَالَ:

translations.en: Rijal al-Najashi: From our Shaykh al-Mufid in his book Masabih al-Nur: reported to me Ibn Qulawayh, from Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh, from Abdallah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Dawud ibn al-Qasim al-Ja'fari, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: عَرَضْتُ عَلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ صَاحِبِ الْعَسْكَرِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ كِتَابَ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ لِيُونُسَ، فَقَالَ لِي: مَنْ هَذَا الْمُصَنِّفُ؟ فَقُلْتُ: تَأْلِيفُ يُونَسَ مَوْلَى آلِ يَقْطِينَ، فَقَالَ: عَطَاهُ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ حَرْفٍ نُورًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.

translations.en: I presented to Abu Muhammad, the Master of the Army (peace be upon him), the book 'Yawm wa Layla' by Yunus, so he said to me: Who is this author? I said: It is the composition of Yunus, the client of the family of Yaqtin, he said: May Allah grant him for every letter a light on the Day of Resurrection.

en.summary: Dawud ibn al-Qasim al-Ja'fari presents the book 'Yawm wa Layla' by Yunus al-Qummi to Imam al-Askari (peace be upon him). Upon being asked about the author, the Imam praises Yunus, stating that Allah will grant him a light for every letter he wrote on the Day of Judgment.
en.seo_question: What is the reward for writing religious books according to Imam al-Askari?

key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْعَسْكَرِ: The Master of the Army, a title for Imam al-Askari
key_terms.يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ: A famous book by Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman
key_terms.مَوْلَى آلِ يَقْطِينَ: Client of the family of Yaqtin, referring to Yunus's status
